messages:
Asha: Quick async QTR OKR check-in for eng + product — please drop a 1-2 line update: 1) what shipped 2) what slipped 3) owner 4) next step. I'll roll up. Keep it short.

Diego: Shipped: autoscaler for model-serving v2 (dedicated pools) — owner @Diego. PR merged, staging load test looks good.
Slipped: routing policy A/B rollout (blocked by infra capacity for region canaries).
Next: need infra confirmation for dedicated burst capacity; target EOW.

Lina: Shipped: per-route latency panel in Redwood Console (PR #882 merged). Owner @Lina.
Slipped: token-cost export endpoint (backend work) — depends on Priya's bandwidth.
Next: Lina to spec UI fields, Priya to pick backend next sprint. :memo:

Priya: Ack — will pick up token-cost export. Also saw a minor p99 regression with continuous batching under specific seq lengths; workaround merged to reduce regressions. Owner @Priya.
Next: monitor next 48h, open follow-up if p99 > target.

Tom: Infra notes: increased dedicated GPU pool in us-west this morning, can support the A/B canary at 10%. Owner @Tom.
Action: need to run a small DB schema migration for rollout (window 02:00-03:00 Fri). Please ACK any services that must opt out.

Marco: From product — routing A/B is priority. Recommend 10% canary -> 1 day health check -> 50% -> full. Also request delaying quantization rollout by 1 week to finish eval regressions. Owner @Marco for rollout policy.

Jen: Quick devex notes: Diego's autoscaler PR still needs one more reviewer (frontend + infra). Pinged @Lina and @Tom. Also pushed a tiny docs stub for the new Console panel — pls review. :eyes:

ci-bot: Build 4521 — branch Diego/autoscaler — tests: passed ✅. Deploy job queued to staging.

Asha: Thanks all — summary so far: shipped: autoscaler (Diego), Console panel (Lina). Slipped: routing A/B rollout pending infra capacity, token-cost export backend. Owners called out.
Next: Tom to confirm migration/opt-outs + finalize canary window; Priya picks token-cost; Marco to delay quantization by 1 week and run evals; Lina + Jen to finish reviews. I'll send a one-paragraph to execs after y'all confirm. :thumbsup:

Diego: ACKed. I'll follow up on reviewer and patch any nits today.

Tom: ACKed migration window and capacity allocation. Will post a short runbook in #eng-infra if anyone needs to opt out.

Lina: ACK — will review Diego PR and docs by EOD.

Priya: ACK — adding ticket to sprint board now.

Marco: ACK — will update rollout schedule and notif timeline.

Jen: ACK — docs review queued.

Asha: Great, thanks everyone. If anything else changes, drop an inline update here and I won't ping.
